intro: One bowl of mac and cheese is about 550 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the macaroni and the buttery cheese sauce.

variants.name: Baked mac and cheese with beef/chicken
Instant mac and cheese (1 small box)

diet: Yes, as an occasional comfort food. It's high in carbs and fat, but quite low in protein. So you may feel hungry again quickly. Go for a small bowl and add protein or vegetables.
tips: Take a small bowl as a side, not the main meal.
Add broccoli or boiled chicken to feel fuller.
Cooking at home? Use low-fat milk and a strong cheese like mature cheddar, so a little goes a long way.

swap.name: Chicken wrap
swap.why: Has protein and vegetables, so it's more filling for fewer calories.

faq.q: Is mac and cheese okay for kids?
faq.a: Yes, as an occasional meal. Add vegetables like broccoli or corn to make it more balanced.
Usually cheddar. Some mix in mozzarella or parmesan for taste and texture.

faq.q: Can I keep it in the fridge?
faq.a: Yes, in a covered container for up to 2-3 days. Reheat with a bit of milk so it doesn't dry out.
